phrase.zh: 让对话有序开始，也让它继续下去。
phrase.en: Give dialogue a way to begin and continue.

visual.zh: 为戈巴独立创作的会议组织拼贴，以讲台、空椅、议程夹和沙漏呼应跨国议会代表之间的会面。画面不是特定议会建筑，也不描绘他的私人遗物。
visual.en: An original conference-organizing collage for Gobat uses a lectern, empty chairs, agenda folio and hourglass to evoke meetings among representatives from different countries. It does not depict a particular parliament or his belongings.

background.zh:
戈巴与迪科曼分享1902年诺贝尔和平奖。他的获奖理由强调对各国议会联盟的务实管理；他组织会议、准备议程与决议，并推动各国议会代表交流。配图把使对话能够开展的具体组织工作作为主题，没有复刻任何一次会议。
1902年和平奖；获得本年度奖项的一半。获奖理由（中文译述）：表彰他对各国议会联盟卓有成效的务实管理。
background.en:
Gobat shared the 1902 Nobel Peace Prize with Ducommun. His citation emphasized practical administration of the Inter-Parliamentary Union. He organized meetings, prepared agendas and resolutions, and promoted contact among representatives. The artwork interprets the work that makes dialogue possible without reconstructing a particular congress.
1902 — The Nobel Peace Prize. Received half of the prize. Official motivation: for his eminently practical administration of the Inter-Parliamentary Union
